sloka: अब्रुवंश्चापि रामेण भरत: सङ्गतो ध्रुवम् ।तेषामेव महाञ्छब्द: शोचतां पितरं मृतम् ॥ २.१०२.३५॥
transliteration: abruvaṁścāpi rāmeṇa bharata: saṅgato dhruvam ।teṣāmeva mahāñchabda: śocatāṁ pitaraṁ mṛtam ॥ 2.102.35॥

translations.english: They said, 'Bharata must have joined Rama. That loud noise must be their wailing over their deceased father'.
